sources.title: Who is Elias the lighthouse keeper? AI fiction tells the same old story
sources.snippet: Like a hack writer or a friend rehashing their glory days over and over, artificial intelligence tends to tell the same old story. For AI agents instructed to write fiction, that tale usually involves lighthouses and a keeper named Elias, according to new Cornell research.
